apiTesting: Mocked Google responses only; no real API key, paid request or live model-quality claim.

scene context omits image/model/audio file payloads
generation is review-only, with no live mutation or history changes
generated operations are shown for review

Apply executes the plan and previews the animation
the whole command batch is one Undo entry

height terrain contains varying surface heights
characters, original-textured equipment and props are actually added

camera travel samples the generated path
lighting commands affect actual editor lighting

checks.name: bad-json response is handled without mutation or automatic retry

checks.name: truncated response is handled without mutation or automatic retry
